title: Kudanwa Kunobva Mupata Mutsvene
intro: Kupfuura mapeji enhoroondo kune nyaya yemweya wakamira pakati pemutongi ane simba nevanhu vese vaiva varanda. Munhu uyu akadanwa kuti anunure rudzi kubva muudzvinyiriri, achiita zvishamiso zvaipesana nemitemo yese yechisikigo. Kubva pagomo dzvene kusvika pachishamiso pamusoro pemvura, muranda uyu waAllah akaona zviratidzo zvaizoramba zvichiitika kwemakore. Basa rako nhasi nderekuziva munhu uyu anoshamisa ane nhaka yakaumba mafambiro enhoroondo yevanhu.
clues: Ndakazvarwa panguva iyo vanhu vangu vakatarisana nemutemo unouraya, uye mhuri yangu yakandiisa mumvura kuti ndiponese hupenyu hwangu.
Ndakawanikwa ndikakurira mumhuri yemutongi akanga arayira rufu rwerudzi rwangu.
Ndakatizira kugomo dzvene uko ndakaona moto pamuti usina kupiswa, uye inzwi rakataura kwandiri kubva mariri.
Ndakadzoserwa kumutongi iyeye nezvishamiso, ndichikumbira kusunungurwa kwevanhu vangu vaiva varanda.
Ndakarova gungwa netsvimbo yangu, rikapatsanuka kuita nzira dzakaoma, rikamedza vaitevera vanhu vangu.
Ndakataura naIshe wangu pagomo kwehusiku makumi mana, uye ndakapihwa mahwendefa enhungamiro yaMwari.
